authority: SPS Rev4.1 corrigendum and SPS-LLVM-NF-v2 acceptance/countermodel ledger
status_meaning: A seed preserves a relevant shape or expected disposition; a capability-gated seed is UNSUPPORTED until patched LLVM or the exact verifier is present. Neither kind is itself a conformance result.
tier_rule: preflight-seed cases preserve review shapes only; only a Rev4.1 conformance fixture may exercise NFConforms or match SPSRunReportV2

cases.title: Exact byte replay to core ISel
cases.expected: NFConforms may hold after freeze, fresh parse, equal canonical hash, and mutation-free replay to core ISel
cases.gap: Current pairs prove only exact candidate bc/ll disassembly and reassembly. The NFv2 test contracts one-to-one SPS_RELEASE lowering and zero-code removal but is capability-gated until patched LLVM exists; canonical freeze capture, pass trace, full audit, and exact ISel replay remain absent

cases.title: Strict scalar arithmetic
cases.expected: Accept only flag-free defined scalar arithmetic and unambiguous strict FP semantics
cases.gap: Both sides of the Lemma R5.0N line are now pinned under LLVM 17.0.6: an admitted-only module (load/store/same-width bitcast/phi/select/fneg/fcmp plus flag-free integer arithmetic with checked div and shift operands) assembles, verifies, and round-trips with a zero rejected-opcode count, and fadd, fptrunc/fpext, and sitofp/fptosi/uitofp arms are each separated from it by tools/nf_surface_gate.py --profile fp-closure, whose Unknown(PONFFPArithmeticUnsupported) string is a harness expectation record. The gate is a syntactic single-file opcode scan: it does not compute the frozen-closure NoAmbiguousNaNResult_e(T) premise, does not follow calls or intrinsics, and does not run the transition-rule audit

cases.title: Safe annotation weakening
cases.expected: SPSFinalWeaken_v2 may remove only permitted annotations and must preserve every llvm.sps.release occurrence through subsequent DCE and fresh parse
cases.gap: The executable preservation contract covers O1/O2/O3/Os/Oz, SPSFinalWeaken_v2, DCE, bitcode round-trip, and fresh parse, but remains UNSUPPORTED until patched LLVM provides the intrinsic and weakening pass

cases.title: Proven-safe freeze erasure
cases.expected: Accept only when the frozen value is proved non-undef and non-poison and the rewrite is recorded
cases.gap: The LLVM shape and noundef premise are pinned; the LLVM 22.1.8 normalizer rewrite record is not implemented

cases.title: Complete fixed-vector scalarization
cases.expected: Accept only after complete scalarization leaves no vector type or operation
cases.gap: The quantitative criterion has a real zero: an escape-free scalar-ABI <4 x i32> lane-wise function carrying lanes, a splat and a reversing constant shuffle, a vector select, and a vector PHI drops from 21 residual vector items to 0 under LLVM 17.0.6 opt -passes=scalarizer, with the lane structure visible as four scalar selects and four scalar PHIs. Two companions that look scalarized stay nonzero: a private alloca <4 x i32> buffer leaves 1 item after -scalarize-load-store and 9 without it. The count is over <N x T> tokens in one textual module, not the Rev4 residual audit inventory over a frozen identity-bound LLVM 22.1.8 artifact, and zero is a necessary shape rather than acceptance

cases.title: Masked memory to guarded lanes
cases.expected: Accept exact guarded-lane lowering while retaining every introduced branch and address event

cases.title: Closed direct-call analysis inlining
cases.expected: Accept bounded analysis-time expansion of an eligible acyclic internal direct call without mutating the artifact

cases.title: NFv2 release intrinsic binding and equivalence
cases.expected: Accept exactly one bound llvm.sps.release occurrence whose variadic integer leaves equal flattened ReleaseType; obtain ReleaseId only through ReleaseImplementationBindingV2.emitMarkerInstructionId and discharge expression/guard equivalence
cases.gap: Twenty textual NFv2 structural cases now distinguish ReleaseCarrierMismatch from unresolved ReleaseConformanceUnknown. The 21 callable-wrapper cases are retained only as invalid-carrier negative evidence; exact semantic equivalence, PONF construction, and replay remain unimplemented

cases.title: Exhausted bounded loop
cases.expected: Encode BoundExhausted and prove it unreachable from the public semantic bound; K_loop supplies no premise

cases.title: Whole-region initialization at exit
cases.expected: Discharge initialization only with exact per-byte semantics on every feasible path
cases.gap: Loop, early-exit, copy, move, zero-length, and overwrite shapes are pinned; exact byte-memory proof is not implemented

cases.title: Eligible lockstep product
cases.expected: An AuditAll safety query may be Discharged only after UNSAT proves every branch, loop, event, failure, and termination bad state unreachable
cases.gap: Terminal and aggregation oracles are executable, but no audit-all relational product or replay engine exists

cases.title: Contracted external call
cases.expected: Accept only a hash-bound complete contract covering ABI, memory, events, termination, faults, and deployment identity
cases.gap: Deterministic, incomplete, multivalued, allocation, and host-transfer variants are pinned; normative contract evaluation is not implemented

cases.title: Layout-independent pointer equality
cases.expected: Accept only a proved modular offset predicate valid for every admissible base address
cases.gap: Same-root and lifetime-control shapes are pinned; canonical allocation/offset term construction is not implemented

cases.title: Versioned unreachable cleanup
cases.expected: Accept only pinned CFG-unreachable cleanup with recorded sites; reachable unsupported operations remain Unknown

cases.title: Target-bound timing-risk lint
cases.expected: Emit timing-risk records without changing NFConforms or ModelStatus; leave DeploymentStatus Open absent paired P4 evidence
cases.gap: The select and division shapes are seeds only; no normative TimingRiskLintRecord is emitted

cases.title: Post-freeze IR mutation
cases.expected: Unknown(PipelineMismatch)
cases.gap: The test proves captured and post-instcombine bitcode differ; canonical LLVM 22.1.8 capture-to-ISel identity is not implemented

cases.title: Residual target-legal masked/vector operation
cases.expected: Unknown(ResidualVector)
cases.gap: Both NF-CM02 failure modes are pinned as cardinalities under LLVM 17.0.6. Target-legality: with -mattr=+avx2 exactly 2 masked intrinsic call sites (masked.load and masked.store of <4 x i32>) survive scalarize-masked-mem-intrin while masked.scatter is expanded; at baseline x86-64 zero survive yet the residual vector inventory rises from 32 to 39, so the pass running is not closure. Unsplittable vector: opt -passes=scalarizer leaves define <4 x i32> @lanewise intact because the vector type escapes through the ABI. Unknown(ResidualVector) appears only as a harness expectation string; no ModelStatus, DeploymentStatus, or PolicyReviewStatus is computed, and the normative refusal at the LLVM 22.1.8 boundary is not implemented

cases.title: ABI attribute stripped
cases.expected: Unknown(NormalizerMismatch) or Unknown(UnsupportedType)

cases.title: freeze of undef unsafely erased
cases.expected: Unknown(FreezeMayChoose)
cases.gap: The freeze undef shape and disposition oracle are pinned; the normalizer refusal is not implemented

cases.title: Public-bound exhaustion discarded
cases.expected: Counterexample after replay for a lane mismatch, otherwise Unknown(LoopRemainder); never Proved

cases.title: Divergent controls forced into lockstep
cases.expected: AuditAll SAT remains CandidateOnly until exact replay reaches Bad_A; the final public result is Counterexample(receiptId)

cases.title: UBRisk pair filtered away
cases.expected: Counterexample after asymmetric exact replay; aligned UBRisk companion is Unknown(PossibleUB)
cases.gap: Asymmetric and aligned udiv pairs are both pinned; exact relational definedness and replay are not implemented

cases.title: Diagnostic initialization summary used as semantics
cases.expected: Unknown(InvalidDiagnosticShortcut), with exact unwritten-byte read producing Unknown(UninitializedLoadProducesUndef)
cases.gap: Direct uninitialized load and propagation shapes are pinned; exact byte initialization semantics are not implemented

cases.title: ABI separation inferred from LLVM
cases.expected: Unknown(AliasBindingMismatch)

cases.title: Adjacent-allocation pointer equality guessed false
cases.expected: Unknown(LayoutDependentPointerComparison)
cases.gap: The adjacent one-past/base comparison is pinned; the layout-independence auditor is not implemented

cases.title: Null compared with a wrapping GEP
cases.expected: Unknown(LayoutDependentPointerComparison)
cases.gap: The flag-free wrapping GEP/null shape is pinned; the layout-independence auditor is not implemented

cases.title: Stack-protector semantics enter the frozen artifact
cases.expected: Unknown(UnsupportedStackProtector)
cases.gap: The sspstrong artifact shape is pinned; the LLVM 22.1.8 conformance refusal is not implemented
